title: HELIX Fund Resource
description: A fund — the fund-accounting dimension (GASB for public institutions, FASB ASU 2016-14 restriction classes for private). Normalizes GASB and FASB conventions into one taxonomy.

helix_id.description: HELIX-assigned unique identifier for this Fund record.

fund_category.description: Map to HELIX fund categories: 'unrestricted_general', 'unrestricted_designated', 'auxiliary', 'restricted_federal', 'restricted_state', 'restricted_private', 'endowment_true', 'endowment_quasi', 'plant_unexpended', 'plant_renewal', 'plant_d. Bound to HELIX terminology: helix/fund-type.

restriction_type.description: Map: 'Without Donor Restrictions'→'unrestricted', 'With Donor Restrictions'→'restricted'. ASU 2016-14 terminology for FASB institutions. GASB institutions use fund-type-based restrictions.

parent_fund.description: Resolve parent fund ID for roll-up.

gasb_fund_type.description: For public (GASB) institutions: 'current_unrestricted', 'current_restricted', 'loan', 'endowment', 'plant', 'agency'. Maps to GASB fund types for statement of net position.

meta.description: HELIX metadata block — present on every resource.
